Name: Vending Machine
Author: Willdan12
Description:
[center]
[b][size=6][color=#3498db]Vending Machines[/color][/size][/b]
[size=4][i]Thirsty for adventure? Grab an ice-cold, buff-giving drink right outside your farmhouse![/i][/size]
[/center]

[line]

[heading]📖 About The Mod[/heading]
[b]Vending Machines[/b] (Version 1.1.2) is a highly convenient and immersive addition to your Stardew Valley daily routine. Have you ever woken up on your farm, looked at your massive field of crops or thought about the deep levels of the Skull Cavern, and wished you had a quick pick-me-up before starting the day? 

Now you can! This mod places a fully functional Vending Machine conveniently near your farmhouse. Instead of spending hours cooking meals for buffs or relying solely on expensive coffee, you can now grab an affordable, refreshing drink to kickstart your morning. It's fast, cheap, and gives you exactly the boost you need to conquer your daily chores or mining expeditions!

[heading]🥤 The Drink Menu & Buffs[/heading]
Every adventurer has different needs. Whether you want to run faster, mine better, or simply survive a tough fight, the Vending Machine has a drink for you. Here is the full selection of ice-cold beverages you can purchase:

[list]
[*] [b][color=#e74c3c]Turbo Cola[/color][/b]
[i]"Fizzy cola that makes your legs move faster."[/i]
Got a lot of ground to cover? Chug this down for a quick burst of speed!
[b]Effect:[/b] Speed +2
[/*]
[*][b][color=#f1c40f]Stamina Surge[/color][/b]
[i]"An energy drink that raises your maximum energy for a while."[/i]
Perfect for those early game days when you have too many crops and not enough energy.
[b]Effect:[/b] Max Energy +50
[/*]
[*][b][color=#2ecc71]Regen Tonic[/color][/b]
[i]"A soothing tonic that slowly restores your energy over time."[/i]
Working hard in the fields? This tonic will keep your stamina trickling back up slowly but surely.
[b]Effect:[/b] Slowly restores energy
[/*]
[*][b][color=#95a5a6]Miner's Fizz[/color][/b]
[i]"Sparkling soda that sharpens your mining skills."[/i]
Your best friend before diving deep into the dangerous levels of the mines.
[b]Effect:[/b] Mining +2
[/*]
[*][b][color=#27ae60]Farmer's Fizz[/color][/b]
[i]"Green juice soda for green thumbs."[/i]
Make harvesting and hoeing a breeze with this earthy, healthy soda.
[b]Effect:[/b] Farming +2
[/*]
[*][b][color=#f39c12]Lucky Lemon Soda[/color][/b]
[i]"Tastes like a four-leaf clover."[/i]
Planning to crack open some geodes or hunt for treasure? Drink this first!
[b]Effect:[/b] Luck +2
[/*]
[*][b][color=#9b59b6]Magnet Mist[/color][/b]
[i]"Draws items to you from farther away."[/i]
Stop running around picking up individual pieces of wood or ore. Let them come to you.
[b]Effect:[/b] Magnetic Radius +128
[/*]
[*][b][color=#7f8c8d]Iron Soda[/color][/b]
[i]"Fizzy soda that toughens you up."[/i]
Heading to the Skull Cavern? Coat your insides with iron and take less damage from monsters.
[b]Effect:[/b] Defense +5[/*]
[/list]
[heading]🛠️ Compatibility & Requirements[/heading]
This mod is built to be lightweight and seamlessly integrate into your game without causing conflicts. 
[list]
[*] [b]SMAPI:[/b] Requires [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] version [b]4.0.0[/b] or newer.[/*]
[*][b]Game Version:[/b] Compatible with the latest version of Stardew Valley.[/*]
[*][b]Multiplayer:[/b] Fully safe to use in Singleplayer. (Make sure all players install the mod if playing in Co-op).[/*]
[/list]
[heading]📥 How to Install[/heading]
Installing the mod is quick and incredibly simple:
[list=1]
[*] Ensure that you have the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] installed on your device.[/*]
[*]Download the [b]Vending Machines[/b] `.zip` file from here.[/*]
[*]Extract the contents of the downloaded `.zip` file.[/*]
[*]Move the extracted `VendingMachines` folder into the [b]Mods[/b] directory of your SMAPI game folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game via [b]SMAPI[/b] and enjoy your cold drinks![/*]
[/list]
